newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 2,600 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Wednesday.
Through Presidio, Texas, around 500 head were sold and through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,300 head were exported.
"Around 90 percent of cattle crossed were previously contracted or retained by owners," USDA said of both Presidio and Santa Teresa. Not enough head was sold to establish trend prices, it added.
Through Nogales, Arizona, around 800 head were sold, although again not enough of any one class or weight to establish market prices.
